issues.on_page: Combining Statement - Nonmajor Governmental Funds: 10 fund columns, no Total column; revenues sum 5,243,633 vs Other Governmental Funds 5,493,196 (p6); expenditures sum 4,945,061 vs 5,759,886
issues.issue: The trimmed PDF is missing the rest of the nonmajor combining statement (remaining fund columns and the Total column), so no nonmajor detail was recorded. Detail is incomplete until the PDF is re-trimmed. Candidate for the CLAUDE.md 'Trimmed PDF is missing pages' follow-up.

issues.on_page: Keno fund column: Charges for services 579,410 (part of Other Governmental Funds 675,990 = Airport 7,746 + E911 71,440 + Housing Rehab 17,394 + Keno 579,410)
issues.issue: 579,410 of 'Charges for services' 4,105,578 is Keno fund revenue (keno/lottery), and the combining statement prints this breakdown by fund. Keeping it whole is defensible because the line label is 'Charges for services', but keno revenue is understated as a result (only Gaming tax 621,186 is in keno/lottery).

issues.on_page: Fees, taxes, permits, and licenses 4,135,454 (Streets/Engineering, budget basis)
issues.issue: On the GAAP statement (p5), Streets/Engineering revenue is Sales tax 3,440,668 + Fees, taxes, permits and licenses 729,735 = 4,170,403. So the budget-basis line is probably mostly sales tax (and/or highway allocation), not licenses and permits. Category is doubtful. Already marked review.

issues.on_page: Fees, taxes, permits and licenses 2,489,713 (p2 general revenues show 'Other taxes and fees' 4,458,288)
issues.issue: This combined line mixes taxes, fees, permits and licenses, and the report gives no breakdown. 'licenses and permits' is a guess; occupation taxes may dominate. The same applies to business-type receipts[11] (568,514). Already marked review.

issues.on_page: Grants 2,957,956, incl. Airport fund Grants 898,966 and Housing Rehab 215,050
issues.issue: The grant source is unspecified. The Airport fund's 898,966 is likely FAA (federal), so part of this may belong in federal grants. Already marked review.

issues.on_page: Sales tax 588,710 (enterprise funds), with Sales tax remitted 630,059 as an operating expense
issues.issue: This is sales tax collected on utility bills and remitted to the state, a pass-through. Recording it as 'sales tax' receipts inflates the city's business-type sales tax. Recorded as printed.
